{{Top|leg}}
'''Point Vigilance''' was one of the [[Six Claws]], spits of land at the western coast of the continent of [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. As such, Point Vigilance jutted westerward into the [[Western Sea (Kesh)|Western Sea]] toward the continent of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]]. The [[Alanciari]], [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] inhabitants of Alanciar, maintained a [[Signal station|signal tower]] at Point Vigilance from which the [[Signal Corps]] could watch for signs of [[Invasion of Alanciar|invasion]] from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who inhabited the western continent. The [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] of [[Garrow's Neck]] lay inland from the Six Claws an housed a garrison of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who could respond in the event of such an attack.
